claim: Learn a plotter's layout, mask and exact figure pixels by running the original plotter on an empty (0x00) and a full (0xFF) canvas instead of decoding graphics or guessing the body.

evidence.text: First layout model was wrong (mask a row and a byte larger, a pixel left); the game's own routine run on an empty and a full background showed the layout.
Running the game's routines on an empty and a full screen gave byte order, empty rows and the mask's corner; the model matched at every shift.
Blank buffers 0x00 / 0xFF at frame 5000 showed the mask is a one-pixel outline; a morphological body left 49 mask pixels uncovered, so masks come from the game.
A masked graphic sits a row below and a pixel right of its mask's corner.
